$comment: VAT and percentage tax parameters. Draft pending research reconciliation.

legalBasis: NIRC Sec 109(CC) & 236(G), as amended by RA 10963 (TRAIN)
vatThreshold.notes: ₱3,000,000 gross annual sales. EOPT mandates a CPI adjustment every three years — confirm whether an adjustment RR has taken effect.

legalBasis: NIRC Sec 116, as amended by RA 11534 (CREATE) — 1% from Jul 1 2020 to Jun 30 2023, 3% thereafter
percentageTaxRate.notes: 3% of gross quarterly sales/receipts for non-VAT taxpayers under the threshold, unless the 8% option is elected.

vatRegistrationDeadline.value: Register as VAT taxpayer before the end of the month following the month the ₱3M threshold was exceeded
vatRegistrationDeadline.notes: Once past the threshold you are liable for output VAT whether or not you register on time.

servicesAccrualBasis.value: Since EOPT, VAT and percentage tax on services are computed on gross SALES (billed/accrued), no longer on collections
servicesAccrualBasis.notes: Output VAT on uncollected receivables may be credited back under conditions in Sec 110(D).
